messages:
maria_cs: Quick capture from PulseHaven onboarding call (10:15am). Putting raw asks here so ENG/Product can triage. TL;DR: finance is watching cost spikes, PM wants prioritization before renewal review.

maria_cs: Key asks / pain notes: 
- per-route cost breakdown in Console (they want CSV/CSV export + per-route trend over last 7 days)
- emb TTL control: embedding vectors feel 'stale' to them; want configurable TTL per-project or per-route
- pin model version per route + soft-fallback when a pinned model is unavailable
- clearer 429/batched-throttle UX and guidance (logs currently opaque)
- onboarding analytics: first-7-day usage/latency/cost dashboard (help them make case to finance)

maria_cs: Customer quotes:
> "We saw embedding cost jump 3x overnight and couldn't explain it to our finance team."
> "We need to guarantee the model we ship with won't change under us during a pilot."

noah_product: Thanks Maria. Good detail. Can you paste the raw example of the embedding spike (date + route name) so ENG has a repro? Also: is the TTL ask about expiring vectors on our side or cache invalidation on their side?

maria_cs: Raw: route: pulse-search-v1, spike: 2026-03-14 02:40 UTC — tokens up but mainly embedding calls increased after a batch job change. TTL ask appears to be they want server-side control (so product can set 24h/7d/etc).

alex_se: Re: repro — I can pull metrics for that window and share graphs. Workaround idea: temporary per-route tag + CSV export so they can show spend by route in their billing meeting.

alex_se: Also noting: pinning + fallback is basically existing rollout config but they want UI-first (a simple toggle). We can add a "pin and notify" option in the Console.

noah_product: Proposal: triage into two lanes — Cost transparency (per-route metering + CSV + onboarding dashboard) = P0 for renewal risk. Operational controls (TTL + pin+fallback + clearer 429 guidance) = P1 for next sprint. Thoughts @taylor_pm?

sam_bot: Created ticket INF-4829 for per-route metering (linked: https://jira.redwood/INF-4829).

sam_bot: Created ticket INF-4830 for onboarding analytics dashboard (linked: https://jira.redwood/INF-4830).

alex_se: I'll attach the PulseHaven metric snapshot and a short reproducer command to INF-4829 by EOD.

taylor_pm: Agree with Noah. Cost visibility is high-impact for renewals. Assigning OWNERS: 
- per-route metering & CSV: owner=noah_product, ETA=2 weeks
- onboarding 7-day dashboard: owner=taylor_pm, ETA=3 weeks
- emb TTL control: owner=alex_se (investigate backend constraints), ETA=backlog for now
- pin model UI: owner=pm-ui, ETA=next quarter (but add minimal toggle in Console as an experiment)

maria_cs: Awesome — will follow up with PulseHaven to say we have tickets and expected timelines. I'll add their finance contact to the thread if we need direct clarifying info.

noah_product: One more ask: can CS provide 2-3 prioritized customer use-cases so we can scope the CSV fields for per-route metering? (e.g., route, model, tokens in/out, embedding count, cost estimate)

maria_cs: Yep — I'll DM the finance contact and paste examples here by tomorrow. :thumbsup:

alex_se: Quick note for ENG: when investigating embedding spike, check for overlapping batch vs interactive jobs -> KV cache churn could explain extra embedding calls.

taylor_pm: I'll slot INF-4829 into next planning board and loop in analytics infra.

maria_cs: Action items summary:
- INF-4829 (per-route metering + CSV): owner=noah_product, attach metrics (alex_se) — ETA 2w
- INF-4830 (onboarding 7-day dashboard): owner=taylor_pm — ETA 3w
- Investigate emb TTL feasibility: owner=alex_se — add findings to INF-4829
- Communicate timelines to PulseHaven and loop finance contact: owner=maria_cs — by EOD tomorrow

maria_cs: tagging the thread with #renewal-risk so other CS folks can surface similar asks.

noah_product: Thanks team. Keep updates short here; we'll convert to PRDs for anything that needs cross-team design.

sam_bot: Note: this thread will be archived in 90 days.
